typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		UploadDate as date,
		DataCenter as string,
		DataAsOfDate as date,
		YearMonth as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		kW as double,
		InsertTs as timestamp,
		DataSource as string,
		Provider as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DataCenter as string,
		DataAsOfDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		YearMonth as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		kW as double,
		InsertTs as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DataSource as string,
		Provider as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		DataCenter,
		DataAsOfDate,
		YearMonth,
		ETLUser,
		kW,
		InsertTs,
		DataSource,
		Provider),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
